description: This PHP class defines data transfer object (DTO) parameters for filtering Buzz feed items in the OrangeHRM application. It extends a base FilterParams class and provides properties and methods to set and retrieve filtering criteria such as share ID and the authenticated user's employee number. It also specifies allowed sorting fields and sets default sorting parameters in the constructor.

classes.name: BuzzFeedFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class to encapsulate filtering parameters specifically for Buzz feed in OrangeHRM, including sorting and filtering by share ID and authenticated user employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sorting field 'share.createdAtUtc' and descending order.

methods.name: getAuthUserEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: setAuthUserEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Returns the filter criteria for the share ID, if set.

methods.name: setShareId
methods.description: Sets the filter criterion for the share ID.
